'''Morgan August''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned on the website for the [[Epsilon Program]][http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm] for [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Morgan August is a resident of [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]] who turned to the Epsilon Program to help him. He states that "Cris Formage is a genius. It's religion without homework!". [http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm]

==Source==
* [http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm ''Epsilon Program Testimonials Page'']
